Business Analyst with 7+ years of Financial Services Consulting experience, specializing in Core Banking, Retail Banking, Cards and Lending. Experienced in driving business and technology transformation across Loan Origination (LOS), Loan Management Systems (LMS), Retail Cards, and Digital Banking platforms. Strong expertise in business analysis, solution design, API-led integration, stakeholder management, and Agile delivery, enabling scalable and business-aligned solutions.
Business Analyst with 7+ years of experience delivering solutions in Retail Banking, Core Banking, Cards and Lending. Experienced in business consulting, stakeholder workshops, and solution design, delivering target operating models and process
improvements across core banking and payment platforms.
Hands-on experience in core banking CASA, Deposit, Loan Origination(LOS), Loan Management (LMS), Accounts Payable automation and
Card lifecycle and dispute management.
Proven expertise in digital transformation, system implementation, and API integration across enterprise banking platforms. Skilled in designing and managing API contracts (System, Process, Experience APIs) for seamless system integration Skilled in requirement gathering, stakeholder management, process modeling (AS-IS / TO-BE), and Agile delivery. Strong background in data migration, UAT coordination, and regulatory compliance (AML, KYC, fraud detection). Proficient in tools and platforms including Oracle Financial Cloud, FIS Integrated Banking Solutions, FIS TRAX, Swagger, Postman, SQL,
Jira, and Confluence.

management.

identifying opportunities for process standardization, improved controls and operational efficiency.

servicing journeys, ensuring alignment between the target operating model and the transformed Cards operating environment.

Supported Agile delivery, UAT governance, defect triage, and implementation of readiness to ensure successful business outcomes.
